cases.rationale: The outdoor street crop contains a prominent actual ornamental clock, traffic signal heads, passenger cars, and small pedestrians on the sidewalks. A distant white boxy vehicle near the central clock post may be a truck, but its body/cab configuration is too small and obstructed to resolve truck identity, so truck is unclear. Ordinary poles, building windows and vegetation do not identify the other defined objects. All 75 definitions were considered.

Identifiable broccoli florets cover portions of cooked chicken on a flat plate. A cropped handled drinking mug is at the upper left, and the meal rests on a dining table. The chicken is not any defined sandwich, hot dog, pizza or cake; green vegetables do not establish additional fruit or vegetable categories. The plate is not a bowl. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual baseball players, an umpire and spectators are visible. The catcher extends a clearly identifiable fielding mitt, and individual blue stadium seats are visible in the stands. The batter's handwear alone would not count as a baseball glove, but the catcher's mitt does. The bat and ball are outside the supplied category set. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The black-and-white crop shows actual children. The boy wears a recognizable striped necktie below the white shirt collar; the girl's collar details do not need to establish a second tie. Clothing and cropped dark background do not identify furniture or other defined objects. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A laptop with its integrated keyboard sits on identifiable bed bedding. An open black suitcase containing clothing fills the lower left. Smaller black bags and straps near the upper middle lack enough clear construction to distinguish a backpack from a handbag or other equipment bag, leaving backpack and handbag unclear. The laptop screen is not a standalone TV, and cords and small accessories do not establish a mouse or remote. All 75 definitions were considered.

The workstation contains a standalone monitor at left, an open laptop with an integrated keyboard, and a separate computer keyboard in front. Headphones and cables are visible; they are not mice or remote controls. Papers beneath the laptop do not show a bound book. The work desk is excluded from dining table, and screen contents do not count as actual depicted objects. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A chocolate-iced ring donut is on a plate beside a handled mug on an eating table. The open black backpack has pack construction and straps; its pocket holds a metal drinking bottle with a cap/neck. A paperback book with visible cover and page block lies across the backpack, and a wooden chair back is visible at upper left. The flat plate is not a bowl and the donut is not a plain bagel or cake. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A built-in conventional oven is clearly visible beneath the kitchen counter, with a smaller countertop toaster oven above. Knives project from a knife block at the top. Behind the glazed cabinet doors are drinking cups/tumblers and stacked open bowls. The work counter is not a dining table, the toaster oven is not a microwave, and the white drawer unit is not an identifiable refrigerator. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The platter contains recognizable broccoli florets and carrots, together with bell-pepper pieces that do not establish other defined fruit categories. A stemmed wine-glass-form vessel is cropped at upper left, and the meal setting identifies the dining table. A serving spoon's reflective bowl and handle are visible across the lower platter. A second overlapping utensil has its working end obscured/cropped, leaving fork identity unclear rather than confirmed. The broad flat platter is not a bowl. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual woman occupies the foreground, with the black-and-white body of a giant panda visible behind her at right, supporting bear presence. The carved stone structure behind her could be a bench back or a railing; insufficient seat context leaves bench unclear. A padded strap/body region at her shoulder plausibly belongs to a backpack, but jacket and bag boundaries are not sufficiently resolved, so backpack is unclear. Background greenery has no identifiable plant pot. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual man sits on a long slatted park bench. At the lower right, an actual bear's fur, rounded ear and head are identifiable despite the crop cutting off most of the animal. The long shared seat is a bench rather than an individual chair, and the plants grow directly in the ground with no pot. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A shaggy black bear holds a bright yellow flying disc across its muzzle. The actual animal's substantial furred body, broad dark nose and pale curved claws support bear identity rather than a dog or plush teddy bear. The yellow object has a flying-disc rim and concentric molded center, rather than a plate or an animal part. Trees and sky supply no additional defined objects. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.
